title: Out-of-range numbers and bad bookmark requests return 500 instead of a validation error
location: backend/routes/products.ts:342-349 (price 1e10 overflows NUMERIC(12,2); stock 2^31 overflows integer)
backend/routes/saves.ts:64-77 (no UUID check on target_id; check-then-insert races UNIQUE(user_id,target_id))
steps: POST /api/products with price 10000000000 -> 500 "Failed to create product"; stock 2147483648 -> 500.
Two simultaneous toggles for the same target -> 200 and 500.
expected: 422 with a clear message for out-of-range or malformed input; idempotent toggle under concurrency.
actual: Database errors surface as 500s (logged as server errors).
impact: Confusing errors for users and noise in error tracking; same class as F-034.
fix: Validate price <= 9,999,999,999.99 and stock <= 2,147,483,647; validate target_id as UUID; use INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING / DELETE ... RETURNING for the toggle.
